hadith:
Oneness, Uniqueness of Allah (Tawheed) - Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:

It rained (because of the Prophet's invocation for rain) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said, 'Some of My slaves have become disbelievers in Me, and some others, believers in Me.'"
message: When worldly distractions compete for your attention, remember that what is with Allah is better and more lasting. Recognize His blessings with gratitude, and honor Al-Majeed, the All-Glorious, through worship.
name:
Al Majeed - الْمَجِيدُ - The All-Glorious

Al Majeed expresses Allah's perfect glory, nobility and generosity. His greatness inspires praise and His bounty calls forth gratitude. This name invites His servants to honour Him in worship and reflect on His abundant goodness.
verse:
Al-Jumu'ah - The Congregation, Friday - 62:11

When they saw the fanfare along with the caravan, they ˹almost all˺ flocked to it, leaving you ˹O Prophet˺ standing ˹on the pulpit˺. Say, “What is with Allah is far better than amusement and merchandise. And Allah is the Best Provider.”
